events: What if every bite of your taco was three times spicier than the last?
Saturday. Dale says he can handle spicy.
Six thousand. A jalapeño. Still fine.
Twenty thousand. A serrano. He is sweating.
One hundred seventy eight thousand. Habanero. Steam out of his ears.
One point six million. Hotter than a ghost pepper. He can see sounds.
Four point eight million. Police pepper spray. In taco form.
One hundred thirty million. Eight times pure capsaicin. Dale is now a rocket.
The real part: a ghost pepper is about one million Scoville units. Pure capsaicin is about sixteen million.
